split.label: When only some pieces of a set stay
split.help: Each set is a Fixed set (kept or returned whole: the rider delivers it whole, and a partial delivery or a return of one piece is refused) or Flexible (pieces may stay on their own). For a flexible set, the kept pieces cost their share of the set price, or each its own price; and you choose whether a free-delivery order owes the delivery charge when the kept part falls under the free-delivery limit. Off until switched on: until then a kept piece costs its share of the set price.
split.riderLine: Set {name}: deliver whole — no single piece is kept or returned
